description: This script generates PEM files with various certificate authority key identifier data, including valid and invalid test cases, using base64 encoding and subprocess calls to external tools.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII text to DER format using an external 'ascii2der' tool.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Creates a PEM formatted block with base64-encoded DER data.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM file with specified DER text, converting ASCII to DER and formatting.
